# Project Documentation Instructions

When documenting SQL database objects in this repository:

- Write documentation in both English and Slovenian.
- Use Markdown.
- Store table documentation in `docs/tables/`.
- Store view documentation in `docs/views/`.
- Store procedure documentation in `docs/procedures/`.
- Use business-friendly explanations, not only technical SQL descriptions.
- For each table include:
  - Purpose
  - Business context
  - Column descriptions
  - Keys and constraints
  - Relationships
  - Usage in Data Quality
  - Usage in Data Governance
  - Usage in Power BI
- For each procedure include:
  - Purpose
  - Input parameters
  - Processing logic
  - Source tables
  - Target tables
  - Error handling
  - Operational notes
- Do not modify SQL files unless explicitly asked.
